header-e-filter">


<link
  rel="prefetch"
  href="https://momcozy.com/?sections=mega-menu3"
  as="fetch"
  crossorigin="same-origin"
  media="(min-width: 1281px)"
>
<script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    var SECTION_ID = 'header-e-filter';
    var HEADER_EL_ID = 'shopify-section-' + SECTION_ID;
    var MEGA_MENU3_SECTION = 'mega-menu3';
    var loaded = false;
    var retryCount = 0;
    var MAX_RETRIES = 3;

    function injectMegaMenu3() {
      if (loaded) return;
      loaded = true;
      attemptInject();
    }

    function attemptInject() {
      fetch(window.Shopify.routes.root + '?sections=' + encodeURIComponent(MEGA_MENU3_SECTION))
        .then(function (r) {
          if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
          return r.json();
        })
        .then(function (data) {
          var html = data[MEGA_MENU3_SECTION];
          if (!html) return;

          var tmp = document.createElement('div');
          tmp.innerHTML = html;
          var sectionEl = tmp.firstElementChild;
          if (!sectionEl) return;

          var headerEl = document.getElementById(HEADER_EL_ID);
          if (headerEl && headerEl.parentNode) {
            headerEl.parentNode.insertBefore(sectionEl, headerEl.nextSibling);
          } else {
            document.body.appendChild(sectionEl);
          }

          // 通知 mega-menu JS 模板已就绪，刷新当前激活的面板
          document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mega-menu3:ready'));
        })
        .catch(function (e) {
          if (retryCount < MAX_RETRIES) {
            var delay = Math.pow(2, retryCount) * 1000; // 1s, 2s, 4s
            retryCount++;
            window.setTimeout(attemptInject, delay);
          } else {
            console.warn('[mega-menu3 lazy]', e);
            // 重试全部失败，重置状态，等待用户下次进入导航区域时再尝试
            loaded = false;
            retryCount = 0;
            var headerEl = document.getElementById(HEADER_EL_ID);
            if (headerEl) {
              headerEl.addEventListener('mouseenter', injectMegaMenu3, { once: true });
            }
          }
        });
    }

    function setup() {
      // 仅 PC 端（> 1280px）才需要 mega-menu3，移动端不加载
      if (window.innerWidth <= 1280) return;

      var headerEl = document.getElementById(HEADER_EL_ID);
      if (!headerEl) return;

      // 鼠标首次进入导航区域时加载
      headerEl.addEventListener('mouseenter', injectMegaMenu3, { once: true });

      // 同时在空闲时间预加载，避免用户悬停时有明显延迟
      if ('requestIdleCallback' in window) {
        requestIdleCallback(injectMegaMenu3, { timeout: 800 });
      } else {
        setTimeout(injectMegaMenu3, 800);
      }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setup, { once: true });
    } else {
      setup();
    }
  })();
</script><style data-shopify>.header-e-filter {
    box-shadow: none !important;
  }

      transform: translateX(0px) scale(var(--mm-logo-scale, 1));
      transform-origin: left center;
    }

    #mega-menu-header-e-filter .momcozy-logo-dark--pc--svg,
    #mega-menu-header-e-filter .momcozy-logo-dark--mobile--svg,
    #mega-menu-header-e-filter .momcozy-logo-light--pc--svg,
    #mega-menu-header-e-filter .momcozy-logo-light--mobile--svg,
    #mega-menu-header-e-filter picture.momcozy-logo-dark,
    #mega-menu-header-e-filter picture.momcozy-logo-light {
      transform: scale(var(--mm-logo-scale, 1));
      transform-origin: center;
    }

    #mega-menu-header-e-filter .show-logo-label .momcozy-logo-dark--pc--svg,
    #mega-menu-header-e-filter .show-logo-label .momcozy-logo-dark--mobile--svg,

    #mega-menu-header-e-filter .show-logo-label .momcozy-logo-light--mobile--svg,

    #mega-menu-header-e-filter .show-logo-label picture.momcozy-logo-light {
      transform: none;
      transform-origin: left center;
    }
  }</style>
  <script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      function clamp(v, min, max) {
        return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, v));
      }

      function isVisible(el) {
        return !!(el && el.offsetParent);
      }

      function setup() {
        var root = document.getElementById('mega-menu-header-e-filter');
        if (!root) return;

        function getEl(selector) {
          return root.querySelector(selector);
        }

        function getActiveLogoEl() {
          var candidates = [
            '.momcozy-logo-dark--mobile--svg',
            '.momcozy-logo-dark--pc--svg',
            '.momcozy-logo-light--mobile--svg',
            '.momcozy-logo-light--pc--svg',
            'picture.momcozy-logo-dark',
            'picture.momcozy-logo-light',
          ];

          for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
            var el = getEl(candidates[i]);
            if (isVisible(el)) return el;
          }
          return null;
        }

        var nav = getEl('.mega-menu__nav');
        var logo = getEl('.mega-menu__nav-logo');
        var btns = getEl('.mega-menu__nav-btns');
        if (!nav || !logo || !btns) return;

        var hasLogo = !!root.querySelector(
          '.momcozy-logo-dark--pc--svg, .momcozy-logo-dark--mobile--svg, .momcozy-logo-light--pc--svg, .momcozy-logo-light--mobile--svg, picture.momcozy-logo-dark, picture.momcozy-logo-light'
        );
        if (!hasLogo) return;

        var minScale = 0.6;
        var gap = 8;
        var rafId = 0;

        function calc() {
          rafId = 0;

          if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
            root.style.setProperty('--mm-logo-scale', '1');
            return;
          }

          var svgEl = getActiveLogoEl();
          if (!svgEl) {
            root.style.setProperty('--mm-logo-scale', '1');
            return;
          }

          if (!isVisible(btns)) {
            root.style.setProperty('--mm-logo-scale', '1');
            return;
          }

          root.style.setProperty('--mm-logo-scale', '1');

          var btnsRect = btns.getBoundingClientRect();
          var limitX = (btnsRect.left || 0) - gap;

          var isShowLabel = logo.classList.contains('show-logo-label');
          var scaleTargetEl = isShowLabel ? logo : svgEl;
          var targetRect = scaleTargetEl.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (!targetRect.width) return;

          var isOverlapping = (targetRect.right || 0) + gap > (btnsRect.left || 0);
          if (!isOverlapping) {
            root.style.setProperty('--mm-logo-scale', '1');
            return;
          }

          var desiredScale = 1;
          if (isShowLabel) {
            desiredScale = (limitX - (targetRect.left || 0)) / (targetRect.width || 1);
          } else {
            var centerX = (targetRect.left || 0) + (targetRect.width || 0) / 2;
            desiredScale = (2 * (limitX - centerX)) / (targetRect.width || 1);
          }

          desiredScale = clamp(desiredScale, minScale, 1);
          root.style.setProperty('--mm-logo-scale', String(desiredScale));

          var safeScale = desiredScale;
          for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            var r = scaleTargetEl.getBoundingClientRect();
            var b = btns.getBoundingClientRect();
            if ((r.right || 0) + gap <= (b.left || 0)) break;
            if (safeScale <= minScale) break;
            safeScale = clamp(safeScale * 0.96, minScale, safeScale);
            root.style.setProperty('--mm-logo-scale', String(safeScale));
          }
        }

        function schedule() {
          if (rafId) return;
          rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(calc);
        }

        schedule();

        if ('ResizeObserver' in window) {
          var ro = new ResizeObserver(function () {
            schedule();
          });
          ro.observe(btns);
        }

        if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready && typeof document.fonts.ready.then === 'function') {
          document.fonts.ready.then(function () {
            schedule();
          });
        }

        window.addEventListener(
          'resize',
          function () {
            schedule();
          },
          { passive: true }
        );
        window.addEventListener(
          'orientationchange',
          function () {
            schedule();
          },
          { passive: true }
        );

        window.addEventListener(
          'load',
          function () {
            schedule();
          },
          { once: true, passive: true }
        );
      }

      if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setup, { once: true });
      } else {
        setup();
      }
    })();
  </script>

<style data-shopify>#mega-menu-header-e-filter .btn-groups__btn {

   }

     border-radius: 0;

   }

     pointer-events: none;
   }
   #mega-menu-header-e-filter .btn-groups {
     display: flex;

  }
  #mega-menu-header-e-filter .btn-groups .btn-groups__btn svg {
    color: var(--h-text-color) !important;

  }
  #mega-menu-header-e-filter .count-box {
    position: absolute;

    letter-spacing: 0;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 10px;

    transition: .3s ease-in-out;
    background-color: #9c5455;
    color: #ffffff;
    text-align: center;
    border-radius: 50%;
    top: -9px;
    right: -10px;
  }

   @media (max-width: 1280px) {
      #mega-menu-header-e-filter .btn-groups__btn {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
      }
      #mega-menu-header-e-filter .btn-groups {
        gap: 12px;
      }
      #mega-menu-header-e-filter .btn-groups__btn--locale {
        display: none;
      }
     #mega-menu-header-e-filter .mega-menu__mobile-toggle {
       display: inline-flex;
     }
     #mega-menu-header-e-filter .mega-menu__mobile-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] {
       display: none;
     }
     #mega-menu-header-e-filter .header-mobile-menu__close {
       display: none;
     }
     #mega-menu-header-e-filter .header-mobile-menu__close[aria-hidden="false"] {
       display: inline-flex;
       pointer-events: auto;
     }
       #mega-menu-header-e-filter .account_btn {
           display: none;
       }
   }</style><script>
  (function () {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      var container = document.getElementById('desktop-language-panel-mega-menu-header-e-filter');
      if (!container) return;
      var loaded = false;

      function appendSectionResponseFragment(target, html) {
        if (!html || !target) return;
        var wrapper = document.createElement('div');
        wrapper.innerHTML = html.trim();
        var node = wrapper.firstElementChild;
        if (
          node &&
          (node.classList.contains('shopify-section') || (node.id && node.id.indexOf('shopify-section-') === 0))
        ) {
          while (node.firstChild) {
            target.appendChild(node.firstChild);
          }
        } else {
          while (wrapper.firstChild) {
            target.appendChild(wrapper.firstChild);
          }
        }
      }

      function runScripts(parent) {
        parent.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(function (oldScript) {
          var newScript = document.createElement('script');
          newScript.textContent = oldScript.textContent;
          oldScript.parentNode.replaceChild(newScript, oldScript);
        });
      }

      function setLocalizationReturnTo() {
        // 在 section 渲染完成后，或表单提交前，动态设置 return_to
        document.querySelectorAll('form[action*="localization"] input[name="return_to"]').forEach((input) => {
          const cleanPath = window.location.pathname.replace(/^\/[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]{2})?(\/|$)/, '/');
          input.value = cleanPath || '/';
        });
      }

      var retryCount = 0;
      var MAX_RETRIES = 3;

      if (container.children.length > 0) {
        loaded = true;
        runScripts(container);
        setLocalizationReturnTo();
      }

      function loadPanel() {
        if (loaded) return;
        if (window.Shopify && window.Shopify.designMode) return;
        loaded = true;
        attemptLoad();
      }

      function attemptLoad() {
        if (window.Shopify && window.Shopify.designMode) return;
        var root = (window.Shopify && window.Shopify.routes && window.Shopify.routes.root) || '/';
        fetch(root + '?sections=header-language', { credentials: 'same-origin' })
          .then(function (r) {
            if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
            return r.json();
          })
          .then(function (data) {
            var html = data['header-language'];
            if (!html) return;
            appendSectionResponseFragment(container, html);
            runScripts(container);
            setLocalizationReturnTo();
          })
          .catch(function () {
            if (retryCount < MAX_RETRIES) {
              var delay = Math.pow(2, retryCount) * 1000; // 1s, 2s, 4s
              retryCount++;
              window.setTimeout(attemptLoad, delay);
            }
          });
      }

      // 鼠标进入 header 区域时加载
      var headerEl = container.closest('header, .header-section, [data-header]') || container.parentElement;
      if (headerEl) {
        headerEl.addEventListener('mouseenter', loadPanel, { once: true });
      }
      // 空闲时兜底加载
      if (window.requestIdleCallback) {
        window.requestIdleCallback(loadPanel, { timeout: 2000 });
      } else {
        window.setTimeout(loadPanel, 800);
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const section = document.getElementById('mega-menu-header-e-filter');
    if (!section || section.dataset.enhanced === 'true') return;
    section.dataset.enhanced = 'true';

    const forceOpen = section.dataset.forceOpen === 'true';
    const navButtons = [...section.querySelectorAll('[data-menu-trigger]')];
    const directLinkButtons = [...section.querySelectorAll('[data-direct-link="true"]')];
    const panels = [...section.querySelectorAll('[data-menu-panel]')];
    const panelContainer = section.querySelector('[data-menu-panels]');
    const navElement = section.querySelector('.mega-menu__nav');
    const navList = section.querySelector('.mega-menu__nav-list');
    const overlayId = 'mega-menu-header-e-filter-overlay';
    let overlay = null;
    let closeTimer = null;
    let overlayReflowHandler = null;
    let activePanel = null;
    let resizeLimitTimer = null;

    const activateHoverState = () => {
      section.classList.add('mega-menu-filter--hover');
    };

    const deactivateHoverState = () => {
      section.classList.remove('mega-menu-filter--hover');
    };

    // 检查并激活匹配当前 URL 的链接
    // const activateMatchingLinks = () => {
    //   const currentUrl = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
    //   const currentPathname = window.location.pathname;

    //   // 检查活动入口链接
    //   const promoLink = section.querySelector('.mega-menu__promo-link');
    //   if (promoLink) {
    //     const promoHref = promoLink.getAttribute('href');
    //     if (promoHref) {
    //       const promoUrl = new URL(promoHref, window.location.origin);
    //       const promoPath = promoUrl.pathname + promoUrl.search;
    //       if (currentUrl === promoPath || currentPathname === promoUrl.pathname) {
    //         promoLink.classList.add('active');
    //       }
    //     }
    //   }

    //   // 检查直接跳转的菜单链接
    //   const directLinks = [...section.querySelectorAll('[data-direct-link="true"]')];
    //   directLinks.forEach((link) => {
    //     const linkHref = link.getAttribute('href');
    //     if (linkHref) {
    //       const linkUrl = new URL(linkHref, window.location.origin);
    //       const linkPath = linkUrl.pathname + linkUrl.search;
    //       if (currentUrl === linkPath || currentPathname === linkUrl.pathname) {
    //         link.classList.add('active');
    //       }
    //     }
    //   });
    // };

    // // 页面加载时激活匹配的链接
    // activateMatchingLinks();

    const getCardLimit = () => (window.innerWidth > 1280 ? 8 : 6);

    const updateOverlayPosition = () => {
      if (!overlay || !navElement) return;
      const rect = navElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      const top = Math.max(rect.bottom, 0);
      overlay.style.top = `${top}px`;
      overlay.style.left = '0';
      overlay.style.right = '0';
      overlay.style.bottom = '0';
      overlay.style.height = `calc(${window.innerHeight}px - ${top}px)`;
    };

    if (!forceOpen) {
      overlay = document.getElementById(overlayId);
      if (!overlay) {
        overlay = document.createElement('div');
        overlay.id = overlayId;
        overlay.className = 'mega-menu__overlay';
        overlay.dataset.active = 'false';
        overlay.style.top = '0';
        overlay.style.left = '0';
        overlay.style.right = '0';
        overlay.style.bottom = '0';
        // 将 overlay 插入到 section 之前，而不是 body
        if (section.parentNode) {
          section.parentNode.insertBefore(overlay, section);
        } else {
          document.body.appendChild(overlay);
        }
      }
      if (overlay && !overlayReflowHandler) {
        overlayReflowHandler = () => {
          if (!overlay || overlay.dataset.active !== 'true') return;
          updateOverlayPosition();
        };
        window.addEventListener('resize', overlayReflowHandler);
        window.addEventListener('scroll', overlayReflowHandler, true);
      }
    }

    const cancelClose = () => {
      if (closeTimer) {
        window.clearTimeout(closeTimer);
        closeTimer = null;
      }
    };

    // 判断鼠标是否在"热区"内（nav-list 或 panels）
    const isMouseInHotzone = (x, y) => {
      // 检查 nav-list 区域（第二行菜单列表）
      const navListRect = navList ? navList.getBoundingClientRect() : null;
      if (
        navListRect &&
        x >= navListRect.left &&
        x <= navListRect.right &&
        y >= navListRect.top &&
        y <= navListRect.bottom
      ) {
        return true;
      }
      // 检查 panels 区域
      if (panelContainer && panelContainer.dataset.open === 'true') {
        const panelRect = panelContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (x >= panelRect.left && x <= panelRect.right && y >= panelRect.top && y <= panelRect.bottom) {
          return true;
        }
      }
      return false;
    };

    let mouseMoveHandler = null;

    const startMouseTracking = () => {
      if (mouseMoveHandler) return;
      mouseMoveHandler = (e) => {
        if (!isMouseInHotzone(e.clientX, e.clientY)) {
          scheduleClose();
        } else {
          cancelClose();
        }
      };
      document.addEventListener('mousemove', mouseMoveHandler);
    };

    const stopMouseTracking = () => {
      if (mouseMoveHandler) {
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', mouseMoveHandler);
        mouseMoveHandler = null;
      }
    };

    const scheduleClose = () => {
      if (forceOpen) return;
      cancelClose();
      closeTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        closeAll();
        stopMouseTracking();
        closeTimer = null;
      }, 100);
    };
    let scrollPosition = 0;

    // 检查元素是否可滚动以及是否在滚动边界
    const isScrollable = (element) => {
      if (!element) return false;
      const hasScrollableContent = element.scrollHeight > element.clientHeight;
      return hasScrollableContent;
    };

    const isAtScrollBoundary = (element, deltaY) => {
      if (!element) return true;
      const { scrollTop, scrollHeight, clientHeight } = element;

      // 向上滚动且已到顶部
      if (deltaY < 0 && scrollTop <= 0) {
        return true;
      }

      // 向下滚动且已到底部
      if (deltaY > 0 && scrollTop + clientHeight >= scrollHeight) {
        return true;
      }

      return false;
    };

    // 阻止 body 滚动的处理函数（但允许 panel 内部滚动）
    const preventScroll = (e) => {
      // 查找最近的可滚动父元素
      let scrollableParent = null;
      let target = e.target;

      while (target && target !== document.body) {
        if (target.classList && target.classList.contains('mega-menu__panel-left')) {
          if (isScrollable(target)) {
            scrollableParent = target;
            break;
          }
        }
        target = target.parentElement;
      }

      // 如果找到可滚动的父元素
      if (scrollableParent) {
        const deltaY =
          e.deltaY ||
          (e.touches && e.touches.length > 0
            ? e.touches[0].clientY - (e.touches[0]._startY || e.touches[0].clientY)
            : 0);

        // 检查是否在滚动边界，如果在边界则阻止默认行为
        if (isAtScrollBoundary(scrollableParent, deltaY)) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
        } else {
          // 允许容器内滚动，但阻止冒泡到 body
          e.stopPropagation();
        }
      } else {
        // 不在可滚动容器内，阻止滚动
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
      }
    };

    // 记录触摸开始位置
    const handleTouchStart = (e) => {
      if (e.touches && e.touches.length > 0) {
        e.touches[0]._startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
      }
    };

    // 锁定滚动（保持滚动条可见）
    const lockScroll = () => {
      scrollPosition = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
      // 阻止鼠标滚轮滚动
      window.addEventListener('wheel', preventScroll, { passive: false });
      // 阻止键盘滚动
      window.addEventListener('keydown', preventScrollKeys, { passive: false });
    };

    // 解锁滚动
    const unlockScroll = () => {
      window.removeEventListener('wheel', preventScroll);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', preventScrollKeys);
    };

    // 阻止键盘滚动（空格、方向键、Page Up/Down等）
    const preventScrollKeys = (e) => {
      const keys = [32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39, 40]; // space, page up, page down, end, home, arrows
      if (keys.includes(e.keyCode)) {
        // 检查焦点是否在 panel 内部
        const isInsidePanel = document.activeElement?.closest('.mega-menu__panel-left');
        if (!isInsidePanel) {
          e.preventDefault();
          return false;
        }
      }
    };

    const closeAll = () => {
      cancelClose();
      stopMouseTracking();
      if (!forceOpen) {
        deactivateHoverState();
      }
      if (forceOpen) return;
      navButtons.forEach((button) => button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
      panels.forEach((panel) => (panel.hidden = true));
      if (panelContainer) {
        panelContainer.dataset.open = 'false';
        panelContainer.classList.remove('is-entering');
      }
      if (overlay) overlay.dataset.active = 'false';
      // 移除父元素的类名，显示 sidebar 按钮、恢复 transform
      const websiteWrapper = document.querySelector('.t4s-website-wrapper');
      const headerSection = section.closest('header.shopify-section');
      if (websiteWrapper) websiteWrapper.classList.remove('panel-is-open');
      if (headerSection) headerSection.classList.remove('panel-is-open');
      // 解锁滚动
      unlockScroll();
    };

    const openPanel = (panelId) => {
      cancelClose();
      const targetPanel = panels.find((panel) => panel.dataset.menuPanel === panelId);
      if (!targetPanel) return;
      panels.forEach((panel) => (panel.hidden = panel !== targetPanel));
      navButtons.forEach((button) =>
        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', button.dataset.menuTrigger === panelId ? 'true' : 'false')
      );
      if (panelContainer) {
        const wasOpen = panelContainer.dataset.open === 'true';
        panelContainer.dataset.open = 'true';
        // 只在从关闭到打开时播放进场动画
        if (!wasOpen) {
          panelContainer.classList.remove('is-entering');
          void panelContainer.offsetWidth; // 强制 reflow
          panelContainer.classList.add('is-entering');
          const onEnd = (e) => {
            if (e.target !== panelContainer) return; // 忽略子元素动画冒泡
            panelContainer.removeEventListener('animationend', onEnd);
            panelContainer.classList.remove('is-entering');
          };
          panelContainer.addEventListener('animationend', onEnd);
        }
      }
      startMouseTracking();
      if (!forceOpen && overlay) {
        overlay.dataset.active = 'true';
        updateOverlayPosition();
      } else if (overlay) {
        overlay.dataset.active = 'false';
      }
      activePanel = targetPanel;
      activateDefaultSub(targetPanel);
      activateHoverState();
      // 为兼容性，给父元素添加类名（隐藏 sidebar 按钮、移除 transform）
      const websiteWrapper = document.querySelector('.t4s-website-wrapper');
      const headerSection = section.closest('header.shopify-section');
      if (websiteWrapper) websiteWrapper.classList.add('panel-is-open');
      if (headerSection) headerSection.classList.add('panel-is-open');
      // 锁定滚动
      lockScroll();
    };

    const activateDefaultSub = (panel) => {
      const subTriggers = [...panel.querySelectorAll('[data-sub-trigger]')];
      if (subTriggers.length === 0) {
        updatePanelContent(panel, panel.dataset.directTemplate, null);
        return;
      }
      const activeTrigger =
        subTriggers.find((trigger) => trigger.getAttribute('aria-current') === 'true') || subTriggers[0];
      activateSubPanel(panel, activeTrigger.dataset.subTrigger, activeTrigger.dataset.subTemplate, activeTrigger);
    };

    const activateSubPanel = (panel, subId, templateHandle, triggerElement) => {
      const subTriggers = [...panel.querySelectorAll('[data-sub-trigger]')];
      subTriggers.forEach((trigger) =>
        trigger.setAttribute('aria-current', trigger.dataset.subTrigger === subId ? 'true' : 'false')
      );
      updatePanelContent(panel, templateHandle, triggerElement);
    };

    const appendRefToAnchor = (anchor, refValue) => {
      if (!(anchor instanceof HTMLAnchorElement)) return;
      const originalHref = anchor.getAttribute('href');
      if (!originalHref) return;
      try {
        const url = new URL(originalHref, window.location.origin);
        url.searchParams.set('ref', refValue);
        const isAbsolute = /^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:/.test(originalHref);
        if (isAbsolute) {
          anchor.setAttribute('href', url.toString());
        } else {
          const relativeHref = `${url.pathname}${url.search}${url.hash}`;
          anchor.setAttribute('href', relativeHref);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (!originalHref.includes('javascript:') && !originalHref.startsWith('#')) {
          const separator = originalHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
          anchor.setAttribute('href', `${originalHref}${separator}ref=${encodeURIComponent(refValue)}`);
        }
      }
    };

    const getDiscernibleLinkLabel = (anchor, fallbackLabel = 'Menu link') => {
      if (!(anchor instanceof HTMLAnchorElement)) return fallbackLabel;

      const ariaLabel = (anchor.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim();
      if (ariaLabel) return ariaLabel;

      const text = (anchor.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      if (text) return text;

      const imageAlt = (anchor.querySelector('img[alt]')?.getAttribute('alt') || '').trim();
      if (imageAlt) return imageAlt;

      const titleAttr = (anchor.getAttribute('title') || '').trim();
      if (titleAttr) return titleAttr;

      return fallbackLabel;
    };

    const ensureDiscernibleLinkText = (anchor, fallbackLabel = 'Menu link') => {
      if (!(anchor instanceof HTMLAnchorElement)) return;

      const accessibleLabel = getDiscernibleLinkLabel(anchor, fallbackLabel);
      if (accessibleLabel) {
        anchor.setAttribute('aria-label', accessibleLabel);
      }
    };

    const renderViewMoreIfNeeded = (panel, triggerElement) => {
      if (!panel) return;
      const content = panel.querySelector('[data-panel-content]');
      if (!content) return;
      const container = content.querySelector('.mega-menu3');
      if (!container) return;
      const grid = container.querySelector('.mega-menu3__grid');
      if (!grid) return;

      // 移除已存在的 view more
      grid.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu3__view-more').forEach((node) => node.remove());

      // 从 triggerElement 获取 view_more 数据
      let labelRaw = '';
      let linkRaw = '';
      if (triggerElement) {
        labelRaw = triggerElement.dataset.viewMoreLabel || '';
        linkRaw = triggerElement.dataset.viewMoreLink || '';
      }

      const label = labelRaw.trim() !== '' ? labelRaw.trim() : 'View More';
      const link = linkRaw.trim() !== '' ? linkRaw.trim() : null;
      // 只要配置了 link 就显示 View More，不判断数量
      if (!link) return;

      // 创建 View More 卡片
      const element = document.createElement('a');
      element.className = 'mega-menu3__view-more';
      element.href = link;
      element.setAttribute('aria-label', label);

      const contentDiv = document.createElement('div');
      contentDiv.className = 'mega-menu3__view-more-content';

      const iconSpan = document.createElement('span');
      iconSpan.className = 'mega-menu3__view-more-icon';
      iconSpan.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      iconSpan.innerHTML = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="29" viewBox="0 0 14 29" fill="none">
                      <path d="M1.375 27.375L10.4859 18.2641C12.6338 16.1162 12.6338 12.6338 10.4859 10.4859L1.375 1.375" stroke="white" stroke-width="2.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
                    </svg>`;

      const labelSpan = document.createElement('span');
      labelSpan.className = 'mega-menu3__view-more-text';
      labelSpan.textContent = label;

      contentDiv.appendChild(iconSpan);
      contentDiv.appendChild(labelSpan);
      element.appendChild(contentDiv);

      // 将 View More 添加到 grid 的最后
      grid.appendChild(element);
    };

    const decoratePanelLinks = (panel, templateHandle) => {
      if (!panel) return;
      const panelId = panel.dataset.menuPanel || '';
      const primaryIndex = navButtons.findIndex((button) => button.dataset.menuTrigger === panelId);
      if (primaryIndex === -1) return;

      const content = panel.querySelector('[data-panel-content]');
      if (!content) return;
      const container = content.querySelector('.mega-menu3');
      if (!container) return;

      let secondaryIndex = null;
      if (panel.dataset.hasChildren === 'true' && templateHandle) {
        const subTriggers = [...panel.querySelectorAll('[data-sub-trigger]')];
        const foundIndex = subTriggers.findIndex((trigger) => trigger.dataset.subTemplate === templateHandle);
        if (foundIndex !== -1) secondaryIndex = foundIndex + 1;
      }

      const panelCta = panel.querySelector('.mega-menu__panel-button[href]');
      if (panelCta instanceof HTMLAnchorElement) {
        ensureDiscernibleLinkText(panelCta, 'View more');
        const ctaLabel = (panelCta.textContent || '').trim();
        if (ctaLabel) {
          const ctaRef = ['menu', `${primaryIndex + 1}`, ctaLabel].join('_');
          appendRefToAnchor(panelCta, ctaRef);
        }
      }

      const viewMoreLink = panel.querySelector('.mega-menu3__view-more[href]');
      if (viewMoreLink instanceof HTMLAnchorElement) {
        ensureDiscernibleLinkText(viewMoreLink, 'View more');
        const viewMoreLabelRaw = (viewMoreLink.textContent || '').trim();
        if (viewMoreLabelRaw) {
          const viewMoreLabel = viewMoreLabelRaw.replace(/\s+/g, '-');
          const viewMoreSegments = ['menu', `${primaryIndex + 1}`];
          if (secondaryIndex !== null) {
            viewMoreSegments.push(`${secondaryIndex}`);
          } else {
            viewMoreSegments.push('');
          }
          viewMoreSegments.push(viewMoreLabel);
          const viewMoreRef = viewMoreSegments.join('_');
          appendRefToAnchor(viewMoreLink, viewMoreRef);
        }
      }

      const allCards = [...container.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu3__card')];
      if (allCards.length === 0) return;

      let tertiaryIndex = 0;
      allCards.forEach((card) => {
        if (!(card instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
        const isLinkCard = card.matches('.mega-menu3__card--is-link');
        tertiaryIndex += 1;
        if (!isLinkCard) return;

        if (card instanceof HTMLAnchorElement) {
          ensureDiscernibleLinkText(card, `Menu card ${tertiaryIndex}`);
        }

        const segments = ['menu', `${primaryIndex + 1}`];
        if (secondaryIndex !== null) {
          segments.push(`${secondaryIndex}`);
        } else {
          segments.push('');
        }
        segments.push(`${tertiaryIndex}`, 'img');
        const refValue = segments.join('_');

        appendRefToAnchor(card, refValue);
      });
    };

    const updatePanelContent = (panel, templateHandle, triggerElement) => {
      const target = panel.querySelector('[data-panel-content]');
      if (!target) return;
      // 生成随机数量（1-3个）的骨架屏卡片HTML
      const generateSkeletonCards = () => {
        // 随机1-3个卡片
        const cardCount = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 1;
        let skeletonHtml = '';

        // 单个骨架卡片样式 + 结构
        const skeletonCard = `
          <div style="
            width: 236px;
            padding: 16px;
            margin: 0 8px 16px;
            background: #F4F4F4;
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
          ">
            <!-- 图片占位 -->
            <div style="
              width: 100%;
              height: 140px;
              background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f2f2f2 25%, #e6e6e6 50%, #f2f2f2 75%);
              background-size: 200% 100%;
              animation: skeleton-loading 1.5s infinite;
              border-radius: 4px;
              margin-bottom: 12px;
            "></div>
            <!-- 标题占位 -->
            <div style="
              width: 70%;
              height: 18px;
              background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f2f2f2 25%, #e6e6e6 50%, #f2f2f2 75%);
              background-size: 200% 100%;
              animation: skeleton-loading 1.5s infinite;
              border-radius: 4px;
              margin-bottom: 8px;
            "></div>
          </div>
        `;

        // 添机动画样式（避免全局污染，内嵌到骨架HTML）
        const animationStyle = `
          <style>
            @keyframes skeleton-loading {
              0% { background-position: 200% 0; }
              100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
            }
          </style>
        `;

        // 循环生成随机数量的卡片
        for (let i = 0; i < cardCount; i++) {
          skeletonHtml += skeletonCard;
        }

        // 组合最终HTML（动画样式 + 卡片）
        return animationStyle + `<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;">${skeletonHtml}</div>`;
      };
      if (!templateHandle) {
        target.innerHTML = generateSkeletonCards();
        renderViewMoreIfNeeded(panel, triggerElement);
        decoratePanelLinks(panel, templateHandle);
        applyCardLimit(panel, triggerElement);
        return;
      }
      const template = document.querySelector(`[data-mega-menu-template="${templateHandle}"]`);
      let contentLoaded = false;
      if (template && 'content' in template) {
        target.innerHTML = '';
        target.appendChild(template.content.cloneNode(true));
        contentLoaded = true;
      } else if (template) {
        target.innerHTML = template.innerHTML;
        contentLoaded = true;
      } else {
        target.innerHTML = generateSkeletonCards();
      }
      if (contentLoaded) {
        renderViewMoreIfNeeded(panel, triggerElement);
      }
      decoratePanelLinks(panel, templateHandle);
      applyCardLimit(panel, triggerElement);
    };

    const applyCardLimit = (panel, triggerElement) => {
      if (!panel) return;
      const content = panel.querySelector('[data-panel-content]');
      if (!content) return;
      const container = content.querySelector('.mega-menu3');
      if (!container) return;
      const cards = [...container.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu3__card')];

      // 检查是否配置了 view_more_link
      let hasViewMore = false;
      if (triggerElement) {
        const linkRaw = triggerElement.dataset.viewMoreLink || '';
        hasViewMore = linkRaw.trim() !== '';
      }

      // 如果配置了 view_more，则最多显示7个，否则显示全部
      if (!hasViewMore || cards.length === 0) {
        cards.forEach((card) => card.removeAttribute('hidden'));
        return;
      }

      const limit = 7;
      cards.forEach((card, index) => {
        if (index < limit) {
          card.removeAttribute('hidden');
        } else {
          card.setAttribute('hidden', '');
        }
      });
    };

    const reapplyResponsiveLimits = () => {
      if (!activePanel) return;
      renderViewMoreIfNeeded(activePanel);
      applyCardLimit(activePanel);
    };

    navButtons.forEach((button) => {
      const panelId = button.dataset.menuTrigger;
      button.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => openPanel(panelId));
      button.addEventListener('focus', () => openPanel(panelId));
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const expanded = button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
        if (!forceOpen && expanded) {
          closeAll();
        } else {
          openPanel(panelId);
        }
      });
    });

    // 为直接跳转链接绑定事件
    directLinkButtons.forEach((button) => {
      // 直接跳转链接悬浮时关闭所有 panel
      button.addEventListener('mouseenter', closeAll);
      // 直接跳转链接点击时添加 active 类
      // button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      //   // 移除其他所有 active 类
      //   section.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu__nav-button.active, .mega-menu__promo-link.active').forEach((el) => {
      //     el.classList.remove('active');
      //   });
      //   // 添加当前点击元素的 active 类
      //   button.classList.add('active');
      // });
    });

    // 活动入口链接悬浮时关闭所有 panel
    const promoLink = section.querySelector('.mega-menu__promo-link');
    if (promoLink) {
      promoLink.addEventListener('mouseenter', closeAll);
      // 活动入口链接点击时添加 active 类
      // promoLink.addEventListener('click', () => {
      //   // 移除其他所有 active 类
      //   section.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu__nav-button.active, .mega-menu__promo-link.active').forEach((el) => {
      //     el.classList.remove('active');
      //   });
      //   // 添加当前点击元素的 active 类
      //   promoLink.classList.add('active');
      // });
    }

    panels.forEach((panel) => {
      const subTriggers = [...panel.querySelectorAll('[data-sub-trigger]')];
      subTriggers.forEach((trigger) => {
        const subId = trigger.dataset.subTrigger;
        const handler = () => activateSubPanel(panel, subId, trigger.dataset.subTemplate, trigger);
        trigger.addEventListener('mouseenter', handler);
        trigger.addEventListener('focus', handler);
        trigger.addEventListener('click', handler);
      });
    });

    if (overlay) {
      overlay.addEventListener('click', closeAll);
    }

    document.addEventListener('keyup', (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') closeAll();
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      if (!activePanel) return;
      if (resizeLimitTimer) {
        window.clearTimeout(resizeLimitTimer);
        resizeLimitTimer = null;
      }
      resizeLimitTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        resizeLimitTimer = null;
        reapplyResponsiveLimits();
      }, 120);
    });

    if (forceOpen && navButtons.length > 0) {
      openPanel(navButtons[0].dataset.menuTrigger);
    }

    // mega-menu3 懒加载完成后，刷新当前已打开的面板内容
    document.addEventListener(
      'mega-menu3:ready',
      function () {
        if (activePanel) {
          activateDefaultSub(activePanel);
        }
      },
      { once: true }
    );
  })();
</script><script>
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
      '--header-height2',
      document.getElementById('shopify-section-header-e-filter').offsetHeight + 'px'
    );
  </script><script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';
    var header = document.querySelector('.t4s-section-header.header-e-filter');
    if (!header) return;
    header.classList.add('shopify-section-header-sticky');
    var HIDE_ON_SCROLL = true;
    var THRESHOLD = 400;
    var hiddenOn = false;

    function hide() {
      if (!HIDE_ON_SCROLL || hiddenOn) return;
      hiddenOn = true;
      header.classList.add('shopify-section-header-hidden');
      header.dispatchEvent(new Event('T4sHeaderHide'));
    }

    function show() {
      if (!hiddenOn) return;
      hiddenOn = false;
      header.classList.remove('shopify-section-header-hidden');
      header.dispatchEvent(new Event('T4sHeaderReveal'));
    }

    var lastY = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    var html = document.documentElement;
    var stuckOn = false;

    // 手动维护 <html> 上的 is-header--stuck：
    // 主题原由 T4SThemeSP.Header 通过滚动监听/IntersectionObserver 控制，
    // 本导航接替后不再命中（data-header-options 为 isSticky:false），需自行切换，
    // 用于驱动 .is-header--stuck .mega-menu-filter 的白底毛玻璃背景。
    function setStuck(on) {
      if (stuckOn === on) return;
      stuckOn = on;
      html.classList.toggle('is-header--stuck', on);
    }

    function update() {
      var y = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;

      // 回到页面顶部：恢复吸顶显示，取消吸顶态
      if (y < 1) {
        header.classList.add('shopify-section-header-sticky');
        setStuck(false);
        show();
        lastY = y;
        return;
      }

      // 未超过阈值：保持吸顶显示（透明态），不触发隐藏
      if (y < THRESHOLD) {
        setStuck(false);
        show();
        lastY = y;
        return;
      }

      // 超过阈值 → 吸顶态；即使下滚隐藏也保持（隐藏时处于屏幕外，无视觉影响）
      setStuck(true);

      // 超过阈值后，按滚动方向控制（已接替主题的导航控制，需手动调用 show/hide）
      if (y > lastY) {
        hide(); // 向下滚动：隐藏导航
      } else if (y < lastY) {
        show(); // 向上滚动：手动调用 show，让导航重新出现
      }
      lastY = y;
    }

    // rAF 节流：高频滚动时同一帧可能多次触发 scroll，
    // 用 ticking 标记保证每帧最多执行一次 update
    var ticking = false;

    function onScroll() {
      if (ticking) return;
      ticking = true;
      window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        ticking = false;
        update();
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });

    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      update();
    });

    update();
  })();
</script><style data-shopify>#mobile-mega-menu-header-e-filter {

  (function () {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      var placeholder = document.getElementById('mobile-mega-menu-header-e-filter-language-placeholder');
      if (!placeholder) return;
      var loaded = false;

      /** Section Rendering API 会包一层 shopify-section；整段 insert 会嵌套 section，主题编辑器会报 HTML 错。只挂载内部节点。 */
      function appendSectionResponseFragment(target, html) {
        if (!html || !target) return;
        var wrapper = document.createElement('div');
        wrapper.innerHTML = html.trim();
        var node = wrapper.firstElementChild;
        if (
          node &&
          (node.classList.contains('shopify-section') || (node.id && node.id.indexOf('shopify-section-') === 0))
        ) {
          while (node.firstChild) {
            target.appendChild(node.firstChild);
          }
        } else {
          while (wrapper.firstChild) {
            target.appendChild(wrapper.firstChild);
          }
        }
      }

      function runScripts(parent) {
        parent.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(function (oldScript) {
          var newScript = document.createElement('script');
          newScript.textContent = oldScript.textContent;
          oldScript.parentNode.replaceChild(newScript, oldScript);
        });
      }

      function setLocalizationReturnTo() {
        // 在 section 渲染完成后，或表单提交前，动态设置 return_to
        document.querySelectorAll('form[action*="localization"] input[name="return_to"]').forEach((input) => {
          const cleanPath = window.location.pathname.replace(/^\/[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]{2})?(\/|$)/, '/');
          input.value = cleanPath || '/';
        });
      }

      var retryCount = 0;
      var MAX_RETRIES = 3;

      if (placeholder.children.length > 0) {
        loaded = true;
        runScripts(placeholder);
        setLocalizationReturnTo();
      }

      function loadPanel() {
        if (loaded) return;
        if (window.Shopify && window.Shopify.designMode) return;
        loaded = true;
        attemptLoad();
      }

      function attemptLoad() {
        if (window.Shopify && window.Shopify.designMode) return;
        var root = (window.Shopify && window.Shopify.routes && window.Shopify.routes.root) || '/';
        fetch(root + '?sections=header-language-mobile', { credentials: 'same-origin' })
          .then(function (r) {
            if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
            return r.json();
          })
          .then(function (data) {
            var html = data['header-language-mobile'];
            if (!html) return;
            appendSectionResponseFragment(placeholder, html);
            runScripts(placeholder);
            setLocalizationReturnTo();
          })
          .catch(function () {
            if (retryCount < MAX_RETRIES) {
              var delay = Math.pow(2, retryCount) * 1000; // 1s, 2s, 4s
              retryCount++;
              window.setTimeout(attemptLoad, delay);
            }
          });
      }

      // 点击菜单开关按钮时触发加载
      var toggleBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-mobile-menu-toggle="mobile-mega-menu-header-e-filter"]');
      toggleBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', loadPanel, { once: true });
      });
      // 空闲兜底
      if (window.requestIdleCallback) {
        window.requestIdleCallback(loadPanel, { timeout: 3000 });
      } else {
        window.setTimeout(loadPanel, 1500);
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const container = document.getElementById('mobile-mega-menu-header-e-filter');
    if (!container || container.dataset.enhanced === 'true') return;
    container.dataset.enhanced = 'true';

    const parentSection = document.getElementById('mega-menu-header-e-filter');
    if (parentSection && !parentSection.dataset.mobileMenuOpen) {
      parentSection.dataset.mobileMenuOpen = 'false';
    }
    const navElement = parentSection ? parentSection.querySelector('.mega-menu__nav') : null;
    const toggleButtons = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-mobile-menu-toggle="mobile-mega-menu-header-e-filter"]')];
    const closeButtons = Array.from(
      new Set([
        ...container.querySelectorAll('[data-mobile-menu-close]'),
        ...document.querySelectorAll('[data-mobile-menu-close="mobile-mega-menu-header-e-filter"]'),
      ])
    );
    const scrollRegion = container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__scroll');
    const triggers = [...container.querySelectorAll('[data-mobile-trigger]')];
    const panels = [...container.querySelectorAll('[data-mobile-panel]')];
    const focusableSelectors =
      'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
    let lastFocusedToggle = null;
    const languagePanel = container.querySelector('[data-language-panel]');
    const languagePanelOverlay = container.querySelector('[data-language-panel-overlay]');
    const languagePanelOpeners = [...container.querySelectorAll('[data-language-panel-open]')];
    const languagePanelClosers = [...container.querySelectorAll('[data-language-panel-close]')];
    let lastLanguageTrigger = null;

    // // 检查并激活匹配当前 URL 的链接
    // const activateMatchingLinks = () => {
    //   const currentUrl = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
    //   const currentPathname = window.location.pathname;

    //   // 检查活动入口链接
    //   const promoLink = container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__promo-link');
    //   if (promoLink) {
    //     const promoHref = promoLink.getAttribute('href');
    //     if (promoHref) {
    //       const promoUrl = new URL(promoHref, window.location.origin);
    //       const promoPath = promoUrl.pathname + promoUrl.search;
    //       if (currentUrl === promoPath || currentPathname === promoUrl.pathname) {
    //         promoLink.classList.add('active');
    //       }
    //     }
    //   }

    //   // 检查直接跳转的菜单链接
    //   const directLinks = [...container.querySelectorAll('[data-direct-link="true"]')];
    //   directLinks.forEach((link) => {
    //     const linkHref = link.getAttribute('href');
    //     if (linkHref) {
    //       const linkUrl = new URL(linkHref, window.location.origin);
    //       const linkPath = linkUrl.pathname + linkUrl.search;
    //       if (currentUrl === linkPath || currentPathname === linkUrl.pathname) {
    //         link.classList.add('active');
    //       }
    //     }
    //   });
    // };

    // // 页面加载时激活匹配的链接
    // activateMatchingLinks();

    const filterFocusable = (elements, root = document.body) =>
      elements.filter((element) => {
        if (!(element instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
        if (element.hasAttribute('disabled') || element.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true') return false;
        if (element.closest('[hidden]')) return false;
        if (!root.contains(element)) return false;
        const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
        return style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden';
      });

    const focusLanguagePanel = () => {
      if (!languagePanel) return;
      const focusTarget =
        filterFocusable(
          [languagePanel.querySelector('[data-language-panel-close]'), languagePanel.querySelector('button')].filter(
            Boolean
          )
        ).shift() || languagePanel;
      if (focusTarget instanceof HTMLElement) {
        focusTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    };

    const isLanguagePanelOpen = () => languagePanel && languagePanel.dataset.open === 'true';

    const setLanguagePanelState = (open) => {
      if (!languagePanel) return;
      languagePanel.dataset.open = open ? 'true' : 'false';
      languagePanel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', open ? 'false' : 'true');
      if (languagePanelOverlay) {
        languagePanelOverlay.dataset.active = open ? 'true' : 'false';
        languagePanelOverlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', open ? 'false' : 'true');
      }
      container.classList.toggle('language-panel-open', open);
      if (open) {
        window.setTimeout(focusLanguagePanel, 30);
      } else if (lastLanguageTrigger instanceof HTMLElement) {
        lastLanguageTrigger.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    };

    const appendRefToAnchor = (anchor, refValue) => {
      if (!(anchor instanceof HTMLAnchorElement)) return;
      const originalHref = anchor.getAttribute('href');
      if (!originalHref) return;
      try {
        const url = new URL(originalHref, window.location.origin);
        url.searchParams.set('ref', refValue);
        const isAbsolute = /^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:/.test(originalHref);
        if (isAbsolute) {
          anchor.setAttribute('href', url.toString());
        } else {
          const relativeHref = `${url.pathname}${url.search}${url.hash}`;
          anchor.setAttribute('href', relativeHref);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (!originalHref.includes('javascript:') && !originalHref.startsWith('#')) {
          const separator = originalHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
          anchor.setAttribute('href', `${originalHref}${separator}ref=${encodeURIComponent(refValue)}`);
        }
      }
    };

    const decoratePanelLinks = () => {
      panels.forEach((panel) => {
        const panelId = panel.dataset.mobilePanel || '';
        const triggerIndex = triggers.findIndex((trigger) => trigger.dataset.mobileTrigger === panelId);
        if (triggerIndex === -1) return;
        const primaryPosition = triggerIndex + 1;

        const panelCta = panel.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__cta[href]');
        if (panelCta instanceof HTMLAnchorElement) {
          const ctaLabel = (panelCta.textContent || '').trim();
          if (ctaLabel) {
            const ctaRef = ['menu', `${primaryPosition}`, ctaLabel].join('_');
            appendRefToAnchor(panelCta, ctaRef);
          }
        }

        const cards = [...panel.querySelectorAll('.header-mobile-menu__card')];
        if (cards.length === 0) return;
        let secondaryPosition = 0;
        cards.forEach((card) => {
          secondaryPosition += 1;
          if (!(card instanceof HTMLAnchorElement)) return;
          const refValue = ['menu', `${primaryPosition}`, `${secondaryPosition}`, 'img'].join('_');
          appendRefToAnchor(card, refValue);
        });
      });
    };

    const updateMenuOffset = () => {
      if (!parentSection) return;
      const rect = navElement ? navElement.getBoundingClientRect() : null;
      const offset = rect ? Math.max(rect.bottom, 0) : 0;
      const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
      container.style.top = `${offset}px`;
      container.style.height = `calc(${viewportHeight}px - ${offset}px)`;
    };

    let offsetRafId = null;
    const scheduleOffsetUpdate = () => {
      if (offsetRafId !== null) return;
      offsetRafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        offsetRafId = null;
        updateMenuOffset();
      });
    };

    const observeLayoutChanges = () => {
      if (!parentSection) return;
      // Keep the drawer aligned when nearby layout shifts.
      const resizeTargets = new Set();
      resizeTargets.add(parentSection);
      if (navElement) resizeTargets.add(navElement);
      const sectionParent = parentSection.parentElement;
      const layoutRoot = sectionParent ? sectionParent.parentElement : null;
      const registerSiblingTargets = (scope) => {
        if (!scope) return;
        Array.from(scope.children).forEach((node) => {
          if (node instanceof Element) {
            resizeTargets.add(node);
          }
        });
      };
      registerSiblingTargets(sectionParent);
      registerSiblingTargets(layoutRoot);
      if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined' && resizeTargets.size > 0) {
        const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => scheduleOffsetUpdate());
        resizeTargets.forEach((target) => resizeObserver.observe(target));
      }
      if (typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined') {
        const mutationObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
          for (const mutation of mutations) {
            if (mutation.target === container) continue;
            scheduleOffsetUpdate();
            break;
          }
        });
        const mutationTargets = new Set();
        if (sectionParent) mutationTargets.add(sectionParent);
        if (layoutRoot) mutationTargets.add(layoutRoot);
        mutationTargets.forEach((target) =>
          mutationObserver.observe(target, {
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['class', 'style', 'hidden', 'aria-hidden'],
            childList: true,
            subtree: true,
          })
        );
      }
    };
    observeLayoutChanges();

    const setToggleState = (expanded) => {
      toggleButtons.forEach((button) => button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', expanded ? 'true' : 'false'));
      closeButtons.forEach((button) => {
        if (!(button instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
        button.setAttribute('aria-hidden', expanded ? 'false' : 'true');
      });
      if (parentSection) {
        parentSection.dataset.mobileMenuOpen = expanded ? 'true' : 'false';
        parentSection.classList.toggle('mega-menu--mobile-open', expanded);
      }
    };

    setToggleState(false);
    updateMenuOffset();
    setLanguagePanelState(false);

    languagePanelOpeners.forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        lastLanguageTrigger = button;
        setLanguagePanelState(true);
      });
    });

    languagePanelClosers.forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => setLanguagePanelState(false)));
    if (languagePanelOverlay) {
      languagePanelOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => setLanguagePanelState(false));
    }

    const isOpen = () => {
      const layout = container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__layout');
      return container.dataset.open === 'true' || (layout ? layout.classList.contains('is-leaving') : false);
    };

    const focusDrawer = () => {
      const preferred =
        container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__nav-button') ||
        container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__close');
      if (preferred) {
        preferred.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      } else {
        container.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    };

    const getFocusable = () => filterFocusable([...container.querySelectorAll(focusableSelectors)], container);

    const openDrawer = () => {
      if (isOpen()) return;
      setLanguagePanelState(false);
      updateMenuOffset();
      if (!(lastFocusedToggle instanceof HTMLElement)) {
        lastFocusedToggle = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;
      }
      // 清除上次动画残留，确保进场动画从 from 帧重新播放
      const layout = container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__layout');
      if (layout) {
        layout.style.animation = 'none';
        void layout.offsetWidth;
        layout.style.animation = '';
      }
      container.dataset.open = 'true';
      container.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      if (scrollRegion) {
        scrollRegion.scrollTop = 0;
      }
      document.body.classList.add('mobile-menu-open');
      // 为兼容性，给相关父元素添加类名（替代 :has() 选择器）
      const websiteWrapper = document.querySelector('.t4s-website-wrapper');
      const headerSection = parentSection ? parentSection.closest('header.shopify-section') : null;
      if (websiteWrapper) websiteWrapper.classList.add('mobile-menu-is-open');
      if (headerSection) headerSection.classList.add('mobile-menu-is-open');
      setToggleState(true);
      window.setTimeout(focusDrawer, 30);
    };

    const closeDrawer = (options = {}) => {
      if (!isOpen()) return;
      setLanguagePanelState(false);
      setToggleState(false);

      const layout = container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__layout');
      const doClose = () => {
        container.dataset.open = 'false';
        container.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        document.body.classList.remove('mobile-menu-open');
        // 移除父元素的类名
        const websiteWrapper = document.querySelector('.t4s-website-wrapper');
        const headerSection = parentSection ? parentSection.closest('header.shopify-section') : null;
        if (websiteWrapper) websiteWrapper.classList.remove('mobile-menu-is-open');
        if (headerSection) headerSection.classList.remove('mobile-menu-is-open');
        if (options.returnFocus !== false && lastFocusedToggle && typeof lastFocusedToggle.focus === 'function') {
          lastFocusedToggle.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }
      };

      if (layout) {
        // 用 class 触发离场动画，与 data-open 状态完全解耦
        layout.classList.add('is-leaving');
        const onEnd = () => {
          layout.removeEventListener('animationend', onEnd);
          layout.classList.remove('is-leaving');
          doClose();
        };
        layout.addEventListener('animationend', onEnd);
      } else {
        doClose();
      }
    };

    toggleButtons.forEach((toggle) => {
      toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
        lastFocusedToggle = toggle;
        if (isOpen()) {
          closeDrawer();
        } else {
          openDrawer();
        }
      });
    });

    closeButtons.forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => closeDrawer()));

    const handleKeydown = (event) => {
      if (isLanguagePanelOpen()) {
        if (event.key === 'Escape') {
          event.preventDefault();
          setLanguagePanelState(false);
          return;
        }
        if (event.key === 'Tab') {
          const panelFocusable = filterFocusable(
            [...languagePanel.querySelectorAll(focusableSelectors)],
            languagePanel
          );
          if (panelFocusable.length === 0) {
            event.preventDefault();
            languagePanel.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            return;
          }
          const firstPanel = panelFocusable[0];
          const lastPanel = panelFocusable[panelFocusable.length - 1];
          if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === firstPanel) {
            event.preventDefault();
            lastPanel.focus();
            return;
          }
          if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === lastPanel) {
            event.preventDefault();
            firstPanel.focus();
            return;
          }
          if (!panelFocusable.includes(document.activeElement)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            firstPanel.focus();
            return;
          }
        }
      }

      if (!isOpen()) return;
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        event.preventDefault();
        closeDrawer();
        return;
      }
      if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
      const focusable = getFocusable();
      if (focusable.length === 0) {
        event.preventDefault();
        return;
      }
      const first = focusable[0];
      const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
      if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
        event.preventDefault();
        last.focus();
      } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
        event.preventDefault();
        first.focus();
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);

    const desktopQuery = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1280px)');
    const handleBreakpoint = (event) => {
      if (event.matches) {
        closeDrawer({ returnFocus: false });
      }
    };
    if (desktopQuery.addEventListener) {
      desktopQuery.addEventListener('change', handleBreakpoint);
    } else if (desktopQuery.addListener) {
      desktopQuery.addListener(handleBreakpoint);
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleOffsetUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleOffsetUpdate, { passive: true });

    const openPanel = (panelId) => {
      panels.forEach((panel) => {
        const isActive = panel.dataset.mobilePanel === panelId;
        panel.toggleAttribute('hidden', !isActive);
        panel.dataset.active = isActive ? 'true' : 'false';
        if (isActive) {
          panel.dataset.entering = 'false';
          void panel.offsetWidth; // 强制重排
          panel.dataset.entering = 'true';
        }
      });
      triggers.forEach((trigger) => {
        const active = trigger.dataset.mobileTrigger === panelId;
        trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', active ? 'true' : 'false');
        trigger.classList.toggle('header-mobile-menu__nav-button--active', active);
      });
    };

    triggers.forEach((trigger) => {
      const isDirectLink = trigger.dataset.directLink === 'true';
      if (isDirectLink) {
        // 直接跳转链接点击时添加 active 类
        trigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
          // 移除其他所有 active 类
          container
            .querySelectorAll('.header-mobile-menu__nav-button.active, .header-mobile-menu__promo-link.active')
            .forEach((el) => {
              el.classList.remove('active');
            });
          // 添加当前点击元素的 active 类
          trigger.classList.add('active');
        });
      } else {
        trigger.addEventListener('click', () => openPanel(trigger.dataset.mobileTrigger));
      }
    });

    // 活动入口链接点击时添加 active 类
    const promoLink = container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__promo-link');
    if (promoLink) {
      promoLink.addEventListener('click', () => {
        // 移除其他所有 active 类
        container
          .querySelectorAll('.header-mobile-menu__nav-button.active, .header-mobile-menu__promo-link.active')
          .forEach((el) => {
            el.classList.remove('active');
          });
        // 添加当前点击元素的 active 类
        promoLink.classList.add('active');
      });
    }

    decoratePanelLinks();
    if (triggers.length > 0) {
      openPanel(triggers[0].dataset.mobileTrigger);
    }
  })();
</script>

const container = document.getElementById('mobile-mega-menu-header-e-filter');\n    if (!container || container.dataset.enhanced === 'true') return;\n    container.dataset.enhanced = 'true';\n\n    const parentSection = document.getElementById('mega-menu-header-e-filter');\n    if (parentSection && !parentSection.dataset.mobileMenuOpen) {\n      parentSection.dataset.mobileMenuOpen = 'false';\n    }\n    const navElement = parentSection ? parentSection.querySelector('.mega-menu__nav') : null;\n    const toggleButtons = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-mobile-menu-toggle=\"mobile-mega-menu-header-e-filter\"]')];\n    const closeButtons = Array.from(\n      new Set([\n        ...container.querySelectorAll('[data-mobile-menu-close]'),\n        ...document.querySelectorAll('[data-mobile-menu-close=\"mobile-mega-menu-header-e-filter\"]'),\n      ])\n    );\n    const \u002F\u002F   \u002F\u002F 检查活动入口链接\n    \u002F\u002F   const promoLink = container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__promo-link');\n    \u002F\u002F   if (promoLink) {\n    \u002F\u002F     const promoHref = promoLink.getAttribute('href');\n    \u002F\u002F     if (promoHref) {\n    \u002F\u002F       const promoUrl = new URL(promoHref, window.location.origin);\n    \u002F\u002F       const promoPath = promoUrl.pathname + promoUrl.search;\n    \u002F\u002F       if (currentUrl === promoPath || currentPathname === promoUrl.pathname) {\n    \u002F\u002F         promoLink.classList.add('active');\n    \u002F\u002F       }\n    \u002F\u002F     }\n    \u002F\u002F   }\n\n    \u002F\u002F   \u002F\u002F 检查直接跳转的菜单链接\n    \u002F\u002F   const directLinks = [...container.querySelectorAll('[data-direct-link=\"true\"]')];\n    \u002F\u002F   directLinks.forEach((link) => {\n    \u002F\u002F     const linkHref = link.getAttribute('href');\n    \u002F\u002F     if (linkHref) {\n    \u002F\u002F       const linkUrl = new URL(linkHref, window.location.origin);\n    \u002F\u002F       const linkPath = linkUrl.pathname + linkUrl.search;\n    \u002F\u002F       if (currentUrl === linkPath || currentPathname === linkUrl.pathname) {\n    \u002F\u002F         link.classList.add('active');\n    \u002F\u002F       }\n    \u002F\u002F     }\n    \u002F\u002F   });\n    \u002F\u002F };\n\n    \u002F\u002F \u002F\u002F 页面加载时激活匹配的链接\n    \u002F\u002F activateMatchingLinks();\n\n    const filterFocusable = (elements, root = document.body) =>\n      elements.filter((element) => {\n        if (!(element instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;\n        if (element.hasAttribute('disabled') || element.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true') return false;\n        if (element.closest('[hidden]')) return false;\n        if (!root.contains(element)) return false;\n        const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);\n        return style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden';\n      });\n\n    const focusLanguagePanel = () => {\n      if (!languagePanel) return;\n      const focusTarget =\n        filterFocusable(\n          [languagePanel.querySelector('[data-language-panel-close]'), languagePanel.querySelector('button')].filter(\n            Boolean\n          )\n        ).shift() || languagePanel;\n      if (focusTarget instanceof HTMLElement) {\n        focusTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true });\n      }\n    };\n\n    const isLanguagePanelOpen = () => languagePanel && languagePanel.dataset.open === 'true';\n\n    const setLanguagePanelState = (open) => {\n      if (!languagePanel) return;\n      languagePanel.dataset.open = open ? 'true' : 'false';\n      languagePanel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', open ? 'false' : 'true');\n      if (languagePanelOverlay) {\n        languagePanelOverlay.dataset.active = open ? 'true' : 'false';\n        languagePanelOverlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', open ? 'false' : 'true');\n      }\n      container.classList.toggle('language-panel-open', open);\n      if (open) {\n        window.setTimeout(focusLanguagePanel, 30);\n      } else if (lastLanguageTrigger instanceof HTMLElement) {\n        lastLanguageTrigger.focus({ preventScroll: true });\n      }\n    };\n\n    const appendRefToAnchor = (anchor, refValue) => {\n      if (!(anchor instanceof HTMLAnchorElement)) return;\n      const originalHref = anchor.getAttribute('href');\n      if (!originalHref) return;\n      try {\n        const url = new URL(originalHref, window.location.origin);\n        url.searchParams.set('ref', refValue);\n        const isAbsolute = \u002F^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:\u002F.test(originalHref);\n        if (isAbsolute) {\n          anchor.setAttribute('href', url.toString());\n        } else {\n          const relativeHref = `${url.pathname}${url.search}${url.hash}`;\n          anchor.setAttribute('href', relativeHref);\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        if (!originalHref.includes('javascript:') && !originalHref.startsWith('#')) {\n          const separator = originalHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';\n          anchor.setAttribute('href', `${originalHref}${separator}ref=${encodeURIComponent(refValue)}`);\n        }\n      }\n    };\n\n    const decoratePanelLinks = () => {\n      panels.forEach((panel) => {\n        const panelId = panel.dataset.mobilePanel || '';\n        const triggerIndex = triggers.findIndex((trigger) => trigger.dataset.mobileTrigger === panelId);\n        if (triggerIndex === -1) return;\n        const primaryPosition = triggerIndex + 1;\n\n        const panelCta = panel.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__cta[href]');\n        if (panelCta instanceof HTMLAnchorElement) {\n          const ctaLabel = (panelCta.textContent || '').trim();\n          if (ctaLabel) {\n            const ctaRef = ['menu', `${primaryPosition}`, ctaLabel].join('_');\n            appendRefToAnchor(panelCta, ctaRef);\n          }\n        }\n\n        const cards = [...panel.querySelectorAll('.header-mobile-menu__card')];\n        if (cards.length === 0) return;\n        let secondaryPosition = 0;\n        cards.forEach((card) => {\n          secondaryPosition += 1;\n          if (!(card instanceof HTMLAnchorElement)) return;\n          const refValue = ['menu', `${primaryPosition}`, `${secondaryPosition}`, 'img'].join('_');\n          appendRefToAnchor(card, refValue);\n        });\n      });\n    };\n\n    const updateMenuOffset = () => {\n      if (!parentSection) return;\n      const rect = navElement ? navElement.getBoundingClientRect() : null;\n      const offset = rect ? Math.max(rect.bottom, 0) : 0;\n      const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;\n      container.style.top = `${offset}px`;\n      container.style.height = `calc(${viewportHeight}px - ${offset}px)`;\n    };\n\n    let offsetRafId = null;\n    const scheduleOffsetUpdate = () => {\n      if (offsetRafId !== null) return;\n      offsetRafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {\n        offsetRafId = null;\n        updateMenuOffset();\n      });\n    };\n\n    const observeLayoutChanges = () => {\n      if (!parentSection) return;\n      \u002F\u002F Keep the drawer aligned when nearby layout shifts.\n      const resizeTargets = new Set();\n      resizeTargets.add(parentSection);\n      if (navElement) resizeTargets.add(navElement);\n      const sectionParent = parentSection.parentElement;\n      const layoutRoot = sectionParent ? sectionParent.parentElement : null;\n      const registerSiblingTargets = (scope) => {\n        if (!scope) return;\n        Array.from(scope.children).forEach((node) => {\n          if (node instanceof Element) {\n            resizeTargets.add(node);\n          }\n        });\n      };\n      registerSiblingTargets(sectionParent);\n      registerSiblingTargets(layoutRoot);\n      if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined' && resizeTargets.size > 0) {\n        const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => scheduleOffsetUpdate());\n        resizeTargets.forEach((target) => resizeObserver.observe(target));\n      }\n      if (typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined') {\n        const mutationObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {\n          for (const mutation of mutations) {\n            if (mutation.target === container) continue;\n            scheduleOffsetUpdate();\n            break;\n          }\n        });\n        const mutationTargets = new Set();\n        if (sectionParent) mutationTargets.add(sectionParent);\n        if (layoutRoot) mutationTargets.add(layoutRoot);\n        mutationTargets.forEach((target) =>\n          mutationObserver.observe(target, {\n            attributes: true,\n            attributeFilter: ['class', 'style', 'hidden', 'aria-hidden'],\n            childList: true,\n            subtree: true,\n          })\n        );\n      }\n    };\n    observeLayoutChanges();\n\n    const setToggleState = (expanded) => {\n      toggleButtons.forEach((button) => button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', expanded ? 'true' : 'false'));\n      closeButtons.forEach((button) => {\n        if (!(button instanceof HTMLElement)) return;\n        button.setAttribute('aria-hidden', expanded ? 'false' : 'true');\n      });\n      if (parentSection) {\n        parentSection.dataset.mobileMenuOpen = expanded ? 'true' : 'false';\n        parentSection.classList.toggle('mega-menu--mobile-open', expanded);\n      }\n    };\n\n    setToggleState(false);\n    updateMenuOffset();\n    setLanguagePanelState(false);\n\n    languagePanelOpeners.forEach((button) => {\n      button.addEventListener('click', () => {\n        lastLanguageTrigger = button;\n        setLanguagePanelState(true);\n      });\n    });\n\n    languagePanelClosers.forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => setLanguagePanelState(false)));\n    if (languagePanelOverlay) {\n      languagePanelOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => setLanguagePanelState(false));\n    }\n\n    const isOpen = () => {\n      const layout = container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__layout');\n      return container.dataset.open === 'true' || (layout ? layout.classList.contains('is-leaving') : false);\n    };\n\n    const focusDrawer = () => {\n      const preferred =\n        container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__nav-button') ||\n        container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__close');\n      if (preferred) {\n        preferred.focus({ preventScroll: true });\n      } else {\n        container.focus({ preventScroll: true });\n      }\n    };\n\n    const getFocusable = () => filterFocusable([...container.querySelectorAll(focusableSelectors)], container);\n\n    const openDrawer = () => {\n      if (isOpen()) return;\n      setLanguagePanelState(false);\n      updateMenuOffset();\n      if (!(lastFocusedToggle instanceof HTMLElement)) {\n        lastFocusedToggle = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;\n      }\n layout.offsetWidth;\n        layout.style.animation = '';\n      }\n      container.dataset.open = 'true';\n      container.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');\n      if (scrollRegion) {\n        scrollRegion.scrollTop = 0;\n      }\n      document.body.classList.add('mobile-menu-open');\n      \u002F\u002F 为兼容性，给相关父元素添加类名（替代 :has() 选择器）\n      const websiteWrapper = document.querySelector('.t4s-website-wrapper');\n      const headerSection = parentSection ? parentSection.closest('header.shopify-section') : null;\n      if (websiteWrapper) websiteWrapper.classList.add('mobile-menu-is-open');\n      if (headerSection) headerSection.classList.add('mobile-menu-is-open');\n      setToggleState(true);\n      window.setTimeout(focusDrawer, 30);\n    };\n\n    const closeDrawer = (options = {}) => {\n      if (!isOpen()) return;\n      setLanguagePanelState(false);\n      setToggleState(false);\n\n      const layout = container.querySelector('.header-mobile-menu__layout');\n      const doClose = () => {\n        container.dataset.open = 'false';\n        container.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');\n        document.body.classList.remove('mobile-menu-open');\n        \u002F\u002F 移除父元素的类名\n        const websiteWrapper = document.querySelector('.t4s-website-wrapper');\n        const headerSection =
